# Application Discovery

## Users and roles

Anonymous prospects, authenticated members, organization owners, and internal operators were considered.

## Outcomes

Each role has an identified primary outcome.

## Surface inventory

| Surface | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Public marketing | Discovered |

## Workflows

Primary acquisition, activation, core-task, administration, and support journeys are mapped.

## Architecture

Route, component, and data boundaries are recorded.

## Constraints

Runtime and access constraints are explicit.

## Evidence

Evidence labels distinguish observed, implemented, reported, assumed, and unknown information.

## Unknowns
